q: Some physical quantities of physics are completely described by a single number (or magnitude) with an appropriate unit. Such quantities are called _____ quantities.
e: Some physical quantities of physics are completely described by a single number (or magnitude) with an appropriate unit. Such quantities are called scalar quantities. Scalar here means a quantity that has magnitude only. Vector: a quantity that has both magnitude and direction.

q: Quantities that have both magnitude and direction are called _____ quantities.
e: Quantities that have both magnitude and direction are called vector quantities. Vector here means a quantity that has both magnitude and direction.

q: In printing, vectors are represented by _____ type, such as $\mathbf{A}$, $\mathbf{E}$, $\mathbf{v}$, $\mathbf{s}$.
e: In printing, vectors are represented by boldface type, such as $\mathbf{A}$, $\mathbf{E}$, $\mathbf{v}$, $\mathbf{s}$. The physics in this sentence is built around boldface.

q: In handwriting, vectors are indicated by placing _____ on the top of their symbols.
e: In handwriting, vectors are indicated by placing arrows on the top of their symbols. The physics in this sentence is built around arrows.

q: The magnitude of a vector $\vec{F}$ is written as _____.
e: The magnitude of a vector $\vec{F}$ is written as $F = |\vec{F}|$. A vector is not finished until you also say the direction.

q: If $\vec{A} = -\vec{B}$, it means $\vec{A}$ and $\vec{B}$ are equal in magnitude but have _____ directions.
e: If $\vec{A} = -\vec{B}$, it means $\vec{A}$ and $\vec{B}$ are equal in magnitude but have opposite directions. The physics in this sentence is built around opposite. Same: lined up together, which is how a bar becomes magnetised.

q: If $\vec{A} = 2\vec{B}$, the magnitude of $\vec{A}$ is two times the magnitude of $\vec{B}$ and the direction of $\vec{A}$ is _____ that of $\vec{B}$.
e: If $\vec{A} = 2\vec{B}$, the magnitude of $\vec{A}$ is two times the magnitude of $\vec{B}$ and the direction of $\vec{A}$ is the same as that of $\vec{B}$. The same as here means lined up together, which is how a bar becomes magnetised.

q: If $\vec{A} = -3\vec{B}$, the magnitude of $\vec{A}$ is three times the magnitude of $\vec{B}$ and the direction of $\vec{A}$ is _____ to that of $\vec{B}$.
e: If $\vec{A} = -3\vec{B}$, the magnitude of $\vec{A}$ is three times the magnitude of $\vec{B}$ and the direction of $\vec{A}$ is opposite to that of $\vec{B}$. The physics in this sentence is built around opposite. The same as: lined up together, which is how a bar becomes magnetised.

q: Using graphical method, the length of the arrow representing a vector is _____ to the magnitude of the vector.
e: Using graphical method, the length of the arrow representing a vector is proportional to the magnitude of the vector. A vector is not finished until you also say the direction.

q: To add $\vec{A}$ and $\vec{B}$, first draw $\vec{A}$. Then draw $\vec{B}$ in such a way that the _____ of $\vec{B}$ is at the tip of $\vec{A}$.
e: To add $\vec{A}$ and $\vec{B}$, first draw $\vec{A}$. Then draw $\vec{B}$ in such a way that the tail of $\vec{B}$ is at the tip of $\vec{A}$. The physics in this sentence is built around tail.

q: The vector sum $\vec{A} + \vec{B}$ is called the _____ vector.
e: The vector sum $\vec{A} + \vec{B}$ is called the resultant vector. A vector is not finished until you also say the direction.
Vector addition is commutative. A vector is not finished until you also say the direction. non-commutative is the opposite class from commutative.

q: In algebraic notation, vector subtraction is expressed as $\vec{A} - \vec{B} =$ _____.
e: In algebraic notation, vector subtraction is expressed as $\vec{A} - \vec{B} =$ $\vec{A} + (-\vec{B})$. A vector is not finished until you also say the direction.
Vector subtraction is not commutative. A vector is not finished until you also say the direction.

q: The process of sub-dividing a vector into two (or) more vectors is called _____ of a vector.
e: The process of sub-dividing a vector into two (or) more vectors is called resolution of a vector. A vector is not finished until you also say the direction.

q: The new vectors obtained from the resolution of a vector are called vector _____ of the original vector.
e: The new vectors obtained from the resolution of a vector are called vector components of the original vector. A vector is not finished until you also say the direction.

q: A useful application of vector resolution is sub-dividing a vector into two perpendicular components, namely, _____ component and _____ component.
e: A useful application of vector resolution is sub-dividing a vector into two perpendicular components, namely, horizontal component and vertical component. A vector is not finished until you also say the direction. Scalar and vector: a quantity that has both magnitude and direction.

q: If $\vec{A}$ is the original vector and $\theta$ is the angle with the x-axis, the x-component is given by _____.
e: If $\vec{A}$ is the original vector and $\theta$ is the angle with the x-axis, the x-component is given by $A_x = A \cos \theta$. A vector is not finished until you also say the direction.

q: If $\vec{A}$ is the original vector and $\theta$ is the angle with the x-axis, the y-component is given by _____.
e: If $\vec{A}$ is the original vector and $\theta$ is the angle with the x-axis, the y-component is given by $A_y = A \sin \theta$. A vector is not finished until you also say the direction.
